title: Chapter 517
text:
The leaders came online one after another, only to see Bennett's solemn expression. He did not say a single word, causing the atmosphere to become heavy. The leaders of the Six Nations were very curious as to what Bennett wanted to discuss with them.

Not long after, the last leader came online, and someone asked, "Bennett, what do you want?"

"Everyone, what I'm about to tell you is a lie that has been deceiving us for decades …"

Bennett slowly said. When the leaders of the Six Nations heard this, they were all astonished. However, as Bennett told them the truth, their expressions changed.

In order to prove his words, Hannes even brought Kedan over and interrogated him severely. Kedan naturally told them everything he knew, and the details were unquestionable. The leaders of the Six Nations no longer had any thoughts of leaving things to chance. Their faces were ashen, and the habit that they had cultivated over the years of maintaining their composure was broken before this piece of news. Anger and humiliation flashed across their faces.

"… That's how it is. The entire planet has been played for a fool. If not for Han Xiao, we would have been kept in the dark forever …"

Bennett clenched his fists and gritted his teeth.

Han Xiao did not know what was happening. Bennett had told the truth to the Six Nations behind his back. However, other than not allowing Bennett to kill Kedan, Han Xiao did not have any other requests, and he had tacitly agreed to it.

"All these years, we …" one of them said with a hoarse voice, and he stopped mid-sentence.

The leaders of the Six Nations had complicated expressions. Although that was the truth, they were the final victors of the Old Era war, and they did not regret what they had done. However, when they thought of the tragic scenes of the Six Nations, the scenes of the missiles exploding into fiery red flowers, and the countries that had been destroyed because of it, they could not help but feel sorrow in their hearts.

The winner was king, and the loser was a bandit. There was nothing much to say about winning or losing, but the mastermind behind the scenes was actually such a small character. They felt a sense of sorrow from the depths of their bones. So what if they ruled Blue Star? Countless advanced civilizations were like humans looking down on bugs in battle. No matter how grand and heroic the battle was, the winner … was still the bug.

Even if they knew the truth, they had no way to pursue the matter.

Everyone's impression of Godora had changed completely, but their rationality was not shaken. Godora was still an advanced civilization that they had to look up to. Now, they also needed Godora's help, but their impression of Godora had changed forever.

Bennett took a deep breath and said in a deep voice, "Last time, when Black Star was negotiating with you, I was behind him. To be honest, at that time, I didn't agree with his way of thinking … But now, I understand his good intentions. He has long seen through this truth. Being backward and weak will only result in being toyed with. I don't know how much of your compromise was fake, but now, I feel that you can see the reality clearly … "

The leaders of the Six Nations were silent. They suddenly recalled the scene from not too long ago. They had painstakingly prepared a grand welcome ceremony and had agreed on the landing coordinates with the Godora disaster relief team. However, the other party had changed their mind at the last minute and left them aside to meet with Black Star.

Actually, this was just a small matter. Although the Six Nations were unhappy, that was all. However, combined with the truth that Bennett had said, this' small matter 'gave them a new feeling … After all, they were not respected.

Bennett's tone was firm. "I will completely stand on his side … If one day, he is disappointed in you and wants me to replace you as the ruler of the world, I will do so. You should know very well that this matter has nothing to do with ambition."

"… We understand."

The leaders of the Six Nations slowly nodded. They were very clear about the weight of these words. Bennett was not pursuing ambition but the hope of their civilization.

"Just like what Black Star said … He is our only choice, the only person who can bring about a 'future' for Blue Star."

"Don't worry, we know how to choose."

The leaders of the Six Nations spoke one after another. They were sincere. This time, they did not have any ulterior motives. In front of the future of their entire civilization, they were willing to sincerely submit to Han Xiao.

There was no reluctance or unwillingness. At this time, the leaders of the Six Nations were only thankful.

They were thankful that a legendary character like Black Star had appeared in Blue Star. He had single-handedly changed the fate of their entire civilization.

…

Under the scorching sun, the plaza of the Sanctuary was bustling with people.

Han Xiao was leisurely heading toward Nagojin. He did not know that Bennett had secretly given him the best assist. Not long ago, Herlous had called and said that Godora was trying to poach him. He was now preparing to go and see how Nagojin was trying to recruit players.

"They don't understand the nature of the players. In their eyes, the players are just special natives. If they use normal methods, I'm afraid the players will not accept them …" Han Xiao shook his head and laughed. Godora did not understand the nature of the players like he did.

At the same time, the area that the Sanctuary had designated for Godora's disaster relief team was surrounded by players. Godora had issued a recruitment notice and attracted many curious players.

"The Blue Star that you are in is located in Star Zone 9 of the Garton Star System. It is under our jurisdiction. The Godora Civilization rules the Garton Star System and is very powerful. We have superb magic technology and can come and go freely in the universe …"

Some of the Godora people were introducing the situation of their civilization. They used all kinds of video materials to describe it vividly. This was Nagojin's plan. He had decided to recruit Inhumans. The first thing he had decided on was to let this group of 'natives' understand the situation in the universe and let them know how powerful the Godora Civilization was. He wanted to show their strength and let these Blue Star Inhumans have a clear idea. Only then would they be able to attract the Inhumans.

Nagojin stood at the side and observed. His idea was good, but the actual situation was very different from what he had expected.

Not only did these Inhumans not show any curiosity about the situation in the universe, they also did not show any envy toward Godora. Instead, they seemed to lack interest.

"That's not right. How can they not be interested?" Nagojin was puzzled.

The surrounding players were indifferent. Nagojin's method was a normal method to deal with the natives, but it was completely useless against the players.

At least half of the people present had seen Pork Bun's Black Star series. Not to mention Godora, they even understood the situation in the entire Shattered Star Ring. The information that these Godora people were talking about was no longer new.

Nagojin was confused. Naturally, he did not know where the problem was, so he patiently watched. After the Godora people finished talking about the overview of their civilization, they started talking about the technological strength of Godora. They displayed all kinds of magic and high-tech products to show off their strength.

The players took a few looks, shook their heads, and left.

"What's the meaning of this? I'm leaving."

"What's there to show off about such things? Do you think we're country bumpkins?"

"You really haven't seen the world."

Seeing this, Nagojin and Godora's people were confused. They thought that the Inhumans were country bumpkins who had not seen the world, but they did not know that in the eyes of the players, these Godora people were the ones who had not seen the world.

Using such things to fool people, do you think we haven't seen magic or technology?

We've even seen continents floating in the universe, and Godora is showing us this?

Country bumpkins!

If Han Xiao was here, he would probably laugh out loud and say, "What's the use of all this? If you have the time, you might as well give out a mission. If you don't give them any benefits, the fourth Calamity won't have the time to waste with you."

However, this was only what most people thought. There were still a number of players who were curious and had the intention of joining Godora's faction. It was not because they were attracted, but because they wanted to try if they could join two factions at the same time.

Nagojin's recruitment process was different from that of the Black Star Mercenary. After all, Godora had its own system, and the recruitment process was more complicated.

There was already a small group of players who wanted to ask how they could join, but at this moment, there was a sudden commotion not far away. The surrounding players gathered spontaneously, and through the crowd, they saw Han Xiao being surrounded by players. They immediately abandoned Godora and rushed over excitedly.

In the eyes of the players, Han Xiao was associated with the word 'benefits'. Every time he appeared, he would cause a commotion. He had already left a strong impression in the hearts of the players, and his popularity was something that Godora could not compare to.

Godora's camp was already deserted, and at this moment, it was even more deserted. The faces of the Godora people turned green and white. They had never encountered such treatment before. They were actually ignored by a group of natives, and many of them were fuming with anger.

Nagojin's face twitched, and he looked depressed. This scene was too different from what he had imagined, and he deeply felt the huge difference in popularity.

Black Star was born on this planet, so it's only natural that they are more popular.

Nagojin calmed himself down and was not discouraged. Although the start was barely satisfactory, he believed that many people would still be willing to join Godora. After all, they were an advanced civilization, and an ordinary mercenary group could not compare to them.

He believed that as long as he continued to explain Godora's situation to the Inhumans, many of them would make the smart choice sooner or later.

Although he had the intention of poaching, Nagojin did not feel that there was anything wrong with it. These Inhumans were free people, and they had the right to recruit others. Everyone was fair, and he would not be unhappy with Black Star … so he felt that Black Star would not be angry because of this.
